name: Hook message
what_to_check: The first line of text, first frame or first spoken words: what stops the scroll
benchmark: Front-loaded and specific to the audience; works with sound off

name: Hook type
what_to_check: The tactic the opener uses
benchmark: No single best type; compare by funnel stage

name: Value proposition
what_to_check: The one benefit the viewer should remember
benchmark: One benefit, stated early

name: Single clear message
what_to_check: Can the main message be restated in one sentence
benchmark: One message per ad

name: Supporting facts
what_to_check: Evidence that backs the message
benchmark: At least one benefit plus one feature or mechanism

name: Problem–solution clarity
what_to_check: Is a problem shown and the product presented as the fix

name: Product shown and role
what_to_check: How visible and central the product is
benchmark: Awareness: brand-led; action: product is the ad

name: Target audience / persona
what_to_check: Who the ad speaks to and whether they would recognise themselves
benchmark: Persona shown in their own context and language

name: Awareness stage
what_to_check: How much the ad assumes the viewer already knows
benchmark: Hard offers to cold audiences are a mismatch

name: Funnel stage
what_to_check: The job of the ad in the campaign
benchmark: Compare creatives only within the same stage

name: Appeal and emotion
what_to_check: Rational or emotional lever, and which emotion
benchmark: Strong emotional response builds long-term brand impact

name: Occasion, season or trend
what_to_check: Timely context the ad rides on

name: Language and localisation
what_to_check: Language of copy and voice, and local fit
benchmark: Match the language of the target audience

name: Offer and price
what_to_check: Incentive and how price is presented

name: Urgency
what_to_check: Time or stock pressure

name: Social proof and trust
what_to_check: Third-party validation shown
benchmark: At least one trust signal for action ads

name: Differentiation
what_to_check: Why this brand over alternatives

name: Claims and disclaimers
what_to_check: Claim type and whether it is backed and readable
benchmark: Claims backed and T&C readable; no cure or guaranteed-result claims

name: Talent / messenger
what_to_check: Who delivers the message

name: Advertiser and partners
what_to_check: Who runs the ad and any partner brands

name: Brand presence and cues
what_to_check: Brand signals beyond the logo
benchmark: At least 2 brand cues

name: Availability / where to buy
what_to_check: Where and how fast the product can be bought

name: CTA
what_to_check: Clarity, wording and placement of the next step
benchmark: Names the exact action; on video both shown and spoken

name: Copy tone and length
what_to_check: Voice of the copy and whether text fields fit
benchmark: Meta primary text ~125 chars, headline ~40; no ALL CAPS

name: Hook in first 0–3 s
what_to_check: Key message or visual hook lands in the first 3 seconds
benchmark: Hook within 0–3 s

name: Brand first appears at
what_to_check: Time of first logo or brand cue
benchmark: Meta: within 2 s; YouTube: within 5 s; repeat through the ad

name: Product first appears at
what_to_check: Time the product first appears
benchmark: Within 2 s on Meta; within 5 s on YouTube

name: Story structure
what_to_check: Narrative template used

name: CTA timing
what_to_check: When the CTA appears and how long it stays
benchmark: On screen 3–5 s and spoken

name: Creative format
what_to_check: Production format of the creative

name: Visual style
what_to_check: Overall aesthetic

name: Production level / native feel
what_to_check: Polish of production and how organic it looks in feed
benchmark: Hi-fi for awareness; lo-fi native for purchase intent

name: Product imagery type
what_to_check: How the product is pictured

name: Background and setting
what_to_check: What sits behind the subject
benchmark: Real settings in natural light for Google images; avoid all-white composites

name: Brand colour use
what_to_check: Whether brand colours are present and leading

name: Colour palette
what_to_check: Character and number of dominant colours
benchmark: 3–4 dominant colours or fewer

name: Contrast and legibility
what_to_check: Subject against background and text against its backdrop
benchmark: Text contrast 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text)

name: Text vs image ratio
what_to_check: Share of the frame covered by overlaid text
benchmark: Meta: over 20% text may reduce delivery; Google images: no overlaid text

name: Typography
what_to_check: Font count, hierarchy and size on a phone screen
benchmark: 2 fonts or fewer; headline > sub > CTA; 10 words or fewer per frame

name: Graphic elements and badges
what_to_check: Stickers, badges and icons added to the creative

name: Focal point
what_to_check: Is there one dominant point of attention
benchmark: One focal point

name: Visual hierarchy
what_to_check: Order the eye follows through brand, product, message and CTA

name: Layout / composition
what_to_check: Structural arrangement

name: Space use
what_to_check: Negative space against element density
benchmark: Blank space no more than 80% of a Google image

name: Product / subject size in frame
what_to_check: Share of the frame filled by the key person or product
benchmark: Shorts: subject 60% or more of the frame

name: People
what_to_check: Presence, face, gaze and expression
benchmark: People early; tight framing

name: Logo placement and size
what_to_check: Where the logo sits and how visible it is
benchmark: Avoid bottom-right and areas covered by platform buttons

name: Aspect ratio and native fit
what_to_check: Frame ratio and whether it was built for the placement
benchmark: Feed 4:5 or 1:1; Reels, Stories, Shorts 9:16; YouTube in-stream 16:9

name: Safe zones
what_to_check: Key text, logo, CTA and product clear of platform buttons
benchmark: 9:16: keep top 14%, bottom 35% and sides 6% clear

name: Opening frame
what_to_check: Whether the first frame works as a thumbnail and stops the scroll
benchmark: No blank or text-less first frame

name: Pacing / cuts
what_to_check: Edit rhythm
benchmark: 3 or more shots in the first 5 s; a cut every 2–3 s for short-form

name: Length
what_to_check: Duration against placement norm
benchmark: Reels 9–15 s; Feed 15–30 s; bumper 6 s; Demand Gen 5 s or more

name: Audio type
what_to_check: What the soundtrack is made of
benchmark: Include audio for Reels and YouTube

name: Sound-off readiness / captions
what_to_check: Whether the message works muted
benchmark: Message readable with sound off
